query: What happens when Apple iPhone SE buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: Seller sold me a defective phone buyer beware

These are used phones. NOT REFURBISHED. Broke back, chip out of screen, charge connection, well it works 1 out of ten times if you hold it just right, will not buy again. Should be kicked off Amazon for misleading customers refurbished means brought back to original standards not reselling someone’s junk they returned or turned in. Tried to contact for seller to do something- no response . Buyer beware
Phone not Strong enough to pull in signal want a refund seller won’t get back to me. Terrible. Phone not strong enough to get signal. I want money back. Seller will not respond. Just terrible.

I was sent a blacklisted product. I bought a tmobile phone, and put in my tmobile sim card, and it gave me a error message saying “SIM not supported “ I took it to an actual tmobile location, and they told me the phone was likely blacklisted because it had been stolen and resold. This seller is a third party seller, so it took extremely long to get my refund, and Amazon customer support really had no control over whether or not i’d get my money back. Buying from this seller is a real gamble, and I would not recommend using third party sellers for purchases this big.
Products are hit and miss with this seller. Have had the phone less than a month and the screen already went blank. Before that happened, when texting the phone would glitch up and go crazy.
Phone was defective and had to return it for a refund.. The product was defective
BuySPRY is a good company. This product was faulty and the screen would not properly turn on. But the company I got it from was super awesome and gave me a full refund.
Didn't work.. The phone itself looked good. BUT it didn't turn on. I sent it back and I'm still waiting for my refund and a response back from the seller.

The audio did work as the phone was talking to me constantly in Spanish. I was dubious UPS would even accept the return as the phone kept talking every time the phone was moved, but fortunately they did. I will credit the seller for refunding what I paid for it but there is no excuse for this kind of nonsense of a faulty device with poor packing. Save your money and buy a new one.
Nice phone, great seller. Had this for about 3 months, works great. The charger didn’t work and seller refunded me $10.

I'm not saying that Electronic Deals acquired this phone illegally, but it certainly did not arrive as stated: Prepaid, AT&T. Electronic Deals doesn't handle customer service on weekends, so I have not been able to contact them. Thankfully, because they are a "Fulfilled by Amazon" seller, Amazon handles the return. I will drop off this item for return, and I should be getting a full refund within 7 days of the phone arriving back at Amazon. Original Review: Do your research on the SELLER before making any electronic purchase. The reviews for this specific phone are mixed because there are multiple sellers who have this item for sale. The iPhone SE retails for $350, and I bought this brand new for $203.

Was unhappy with return but they finally refunded the entire amount.. The phone was great when I received it. Unfortunately it dropped and the screen cracked within the first week. I had just put the scree protector on the phone and it cracked at the bottom just below the screen protector. I returned it. The phone was $283. They only refunded $22.72 and said there was a $200 restocking fee, however, after complaining, they refunded the entire amount.

I was sent a product that had issues, request a full refund when phone is received!. I received a phone that wasn't wiped clean from previous user. Their birthdate was still on the phone among other website issues.?! The battery was weak , and needed to be charged a lot. I'm not on the phone that often at all. It also took a long time to recharge. These are reasons for returning phone and requesting a full refund $208.01. Nancy McCleary

Camera does not work properly. Everything works fine but the rear facing camera , sometimes it freezes and then goes black, I have to turn off the phone. Called amazon service for a replacement and was told the seller would contact me in a couple of days, they never contacted me. I don't recommend this seller

Phone froze repeatedly at initial setup screen - item returned to seller. Can't recommend this seller: 1. Phone froze on the third initial setup screen (country selection screen). Re-started about twenty times and the phone froze on the same setup screen each time. 2. Sent email to address provided with product for support - email returned, invalid email address. 3. Phone number provided with product for support was number in China ("+86") country code. 4. Phone returned for refund.
PHONE DOES NOT WORK. AVOID THIS SELLER. So angry with this product. Phone does not fully work. IT DOES NOT CHARGE AND RANDOMLY SHUT OFFS. BEWARE OF THIS SELLER

Returned and haven’t received refund. They responded quickly and processed refund. Instructions had gone to Amazon email which I didn’t even know existed. Phone had a small glitch with the sound so I purchased another instead. I returned this one well within the 90 day guarantee. It says they refunded $134 but it’s not on my account and the full cost was $234 so I'm very confused. Can’t get in touch with anyone.

Not even fully refurbished. The audio doesn’t work out of the speaker (we didn’t realize this at first because we got it as a “home phone” to FaceTime our daughter as she learns to stay home short times by herself. Works on speaker phone not through the ear part. Screen was not great. Took it in to be repaired and they asked where we took it before because it was done incorrect. They repaired a lot of parts but tried 3 different audio options and had no luck. Cost us over $100 to repair the parts. Contacted the seller with no reply. Definitely faulty equipment!

Don't expect an immediate refund.. There were issues with the device where it required a passcode when a passcode had not been set at all. returned and requested a refund on 8/17 and have yet to receive the refund as of 8/22. I have seen similar reviews, and If I don't get a refund, don't risk your money here.

Scam. Phone was all scratched up and screen had a gouge in it and the speakers are busted. Very disappointing and they made it to where you can’t request a refund. So it proves that this person knew it was a messed up sale. Someday karma will come to you. FY!
